title: "Beat the ATS"? They Lied | Ex-Google Recruiter Reveals the Resume Truth
description:
Get my Job Seekers Toolkit: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/get-my-job-seekers-toolkit-now
 Book a 1:1: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/book-a-1hour-career-coaching-session-with-me-eq3bs

They told you to “beat the ATS.” They lied.

If you’ve ever applied to hundreds of jobs and blamed the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) for auto rejecting you, this video will change everything. I’m an ex-Google recruiter who’s reviewed over 100,000 resumes, and I’m breaking down the 5 biggest ATS myths that are wasting your time and sabotaging your job search.

 You’ll learn:

Why “ATS-compliance” is a scam used to sell fake resume tools

How these systems actually work (with proof from behind the scenes)

What to do instead to get seen, read, and remembered

Stop optimizing for fake algorithms and start writing resumes that humans care about. Because clarity gets interviews. Scoring systems don’t.

Check out Sam Straun's video here: https://youtu.be/0sQm1lvHa9M?si=Z8LzRZqmR-vM2NjI
